description: Synthetic knowledge base and labelled anomalies for the opt-in RAG evaluation. All companies, codes and events are invented.

documents.title: ECN-2026-014 Coating thickness increase for outdoor frames
documents.text: ECN-2026-014 raises the minimum dry film thickness of the epoxy powder coat MAT-10023 on PROD-A frames from 60 to 80 micrometres to meet the new salt-spray requirement. Expected coating consumption per frame increases by about 30 percent. Effective from 15 February 2026.

documents.title: ECN-2026-019 Steel sheet gauge change
documents.text: Frame side panels move from 1.2 mm cold-rolled sheet MAT-20011 to 1.5 mm sheet MAT-20012 for stiffness. Part drawings for PROD-A revision C apply. BOM update in the ERP system is pending.

documents.title: Housing wall redesign
documents.text: The motor housing casting wall is thickened from 3 mm to 4 mm around the mounting bosses after field cracks. Casting weight per housing rises from 1.10 kg to 1.32 kg of die-cast aluminium alloy.

documents.title: ECN-2026-022 Winding wire specification
documents.text: Stator winding wire MAT-40007 changes from grade 1 to grade 2 enamel insulation for higher thermal class. Supplier price for the new grade is higher by 12 percent per kilogram. Applies to PROD-B from work order WO-2026-052.

documents.title: Solder paste alloy switch
documents.text: The board assembly line replaces the lead-free solder paste with a low-silver alloy to reduce cost. Stencil apertures are enlarged by 10 percent to keep joint quality, which increases paste deposited per board.

documents.title: ECN-2026-027 Enclosure resin substitution
documents.text: PROD-D enclosures switch from ABS resin MAT-60004 to PC/ABS blend MAT-60009 for flame retardancy. ABS is no longer issued for new work orders. The PC/ABS blend costs more per kilogram.

documents.title: Packaging carton redesign
documents.text: Shipping cartons MAT-70001 are resized for pallet optimisation. Carton count per product is unchanged and unit price drops slightly.

documents.title: Fastener standardisation
documents.text: M4 screws MAT-80003 are standardised to a single zinc-flake coated variant across all frames and housings. Four screws per assembly are replaced by six on PROD-E to meet vibration testing.

documents.title: ECN-2025-040 Old coating colour change
documents.text: Colour of the powder coat MAT-10023 changed from RAL 7016 to RAL 7021. No change in thickness or consumption. Superseded.

documents.title: PCB panel layout change
documents.text: Circuit board blanks MAT-50002 move from 4-up to 3-up panels because of a larger board outline on PROD-C revision D. Blank consumption per board rises by one third.

documents.title: Low-VOC coating introduction
documents.text: PROD-E adopts the low-VOC coating MAT-10024 in place of the solvent-based coating. Coverage per litre is lower, so more coating is required per part.

documents.title: Conformal coat removed
documents.text: Conformal coating MAT-50015 on PROD-C boards is no longer required after the enclosure seal improvement. Coating usage should drop to zero from February.

documents.title: QR-2026-112 Coating thickness audit line 2
documents.text: Audit on paint line 2 found dry film thickness on frames averaging 95 micrometres, above the 80 micrometre target. Gun pressure was set high after the recipe change. Affects work orders WO-2026-031 and WO-2026-044.

documents.title: Powder coat rework
documents.text: Twelve percent of outdoor frames were stripped and recoated in March because of orange-peel surface defects, consuming additional powder for each reworked frame.

documents.title: QR-2026-118 Casting porosity scrap
documents.text: Porosity in motor housing castings caused a scrap rate of 9 percent in March versus 3 percent in January. Scrapped castings for PROD-B are remelted with a melt loss of aluminium alloy MAT-30005.

documents.title: Winding rejects
documents.text: Insulation test failures on stator windings led to rewinding of 6 percent of units. Copper wire from the scrapped windings is not recovered.

documents.title: QR-2026-125 Solder bridging after stencil change
documents.text: Solder bridging defects rose on PROD-C boards after the stencil aperture change. Boards were reworked with additional solder paste MAT-50010 on work order WO-2026-067.

documents.title: Moulding short shots
documents.text: Short shots on enclosure moulding with the new blend raised start-up purge waste. Purged resin per shift doubled during process tuning in March.

documents.title: Carton crush test pass
documents.text: New shipping cartons MAT-70001 passed compression and drop tests. No issues found.

documents.title: QR-2026-131 Steel sheet supplier lot
documents.text: Incoming inspection of sheet MAT-20011 lot 7781 found thickness at the upper tolerance limit, increasing weight per panel by about 4 percent. Lot released under concession for PROD-A.

documents.title: Board depaneling breakage
documents.text: Depaneling breakage on the new 3-up circuit board panels scrapped 5 percent of boards in early March.

documents.title: QR-2025-090 Old coating adhesion issue
documents.text: Adhesion failures of coat MAT-10023 in August 2025 were traced to pretreatment. Closed in September 2025.

documents.title: Screw torque failures
documents.text: Torque audit found stripped threads on M4 screws MAT-80003 in PROD-E assemblies, leading to screw replacement on 8 percent of units in WO-2026-085.

documents.title: Low-VOC coating sagging
documents.text: Sagging on parts coated with the low-VOC coating required a second coat on 10 percent of parts.

documents.title: Case 2025-03 Paint overuse after spec change
documents.text: Confirmed cause: coating consumption on frames rose after a film-thickness specification change while the BOM still held the old usage. Resolution: BOM coating usage updated and spray guns recalibrated. Material MAT-10023.

documents.title: Case 2024-11 Steel weight variance from gauge change
documents.text: Confirmed cause: drawings moved to a thicker gauge before the ERP BOM was updated, so issued steel exceeded plan. Resolution: synchronise BOM with drawing release.

documents.title: Case 2025-07 Casting scrap drove alloy usage
documents.text: Confirmed cause: porosity scrap in die casting increased aluminium alloy consumption per good housing. Resolution: degassing procedure and die temperature control. Products: PROD-B.

documents.title: Case 2025-02 Copper price increase
documents.text: Confirmed cause: winding wire unit cost rose after a supplier price increase linked to the copper index; quantity per unit was unchanged. Material MAT-40007.

documents.title: Case 2025-09 Solder paste waste
documents.text: Confirmed cause: solder paste usage rose after stencil apertures were enlarged and paste was scrapped at shift end. Resolution: smaller jars and shift-end handling rules.

documents.title: Case 2025-05 Resin substitution not in BOM
documents.text: Confirmed cause: a resin substitution on enclosures was implemented on the shop floor before the BOM change, so the new resin appeared as an unplanned material and the old resin disappeared. Material MAT-60009 replaced MAT-60004.

documents.title: Case 2025-01 Carton price change
documents.text: Confirmed cause: carton unit price changed with a new supplier contract. No usage change.

documents.title: Case 2025-10 Screw usage after design change
documents.text: Confirmed cause: screws per assembly increased after a vibration-driven design change and replacement of stripped screws during assembly. Material MAT-80003.

documents.title: Case 2025-03b PCB panelisation yield
documents.text: Confirmed cause: fewer boards per panel after an outline change increased blank consumption per board; depaneling scrap added further losses.

documents.title: Case 2024-08 Coating rework
documents.text: Confirmed cause: surface defects led to stripping and recoating, doubling powder use on affected parts. Resolution: oven temperature profile corrected.

documents.title: Case 2025-06 Low-VOC coverage
documents.text: Confirmed cause: lower coverage of a low-VOC coating increased litres used per part; BOM had kept the old coverage rate. Material MAT-10024.

documents.title: Case 2025-12 Obsolete conformal coat still issued
documents.text: Confirmed cause: a removed coating remained in the backflush BOM, so material was still issued after the design change. Material MAT-50015.
